FN-ZQQ6TKR-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 360
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Chad Robertson
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/03/2025
House Bill 360 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the
Administrative Office of Courts by requiring the office to establish policies and procedures
relating to consolidation of all specialty courts into an accountability court program.
